QUOTE: `_bindings.py` is auto-generated by `scripts/gen_bindings.py` from `entropic.h`. Pre-commit runs `gen-bindings --check`, so the committed file can't drift from the header.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says bindings are generated from the header and that a pre-commit `gen-bindings --check` stops drift. That is the mechanism the item asks for. It doesn't spell out "re-runs and diffs", but a `--check` mode on a generator implies it.
